scene.title: The scene
scene.text: This is where your program happens. You can drag the scene to look around and use the buttons to zoom.

goals.title: Your goals
goals.text: These are the tasks you need to finish. A task gets a tick when it is done.

editor.title: The editor
editor.text: This is where you write your program. You type one instruction on each line.

run.title: Run and Restart
run.text: To test your program, press the Run button. The Restart button puts everything back to the start.

notebook.title: The notebook
notebook.text: This list shows what your wizard can do. You can click an example to put it in the editor.

hint.title: Hints and help
hint.text: The Hint button gives a clue when your code fails. The question mark opens this guide again.

method.title: How we learn
method.text: We try, we watch what happens and we try again. Now let us write your first instruction!
